generations.requestPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ORIGINAL GAME ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, transparent background.
Input reference: the officer turnaround fixes the character identity, white suit design, human adult proportions, helmet, black joints, black belt/backpack and SMALL BLACK SIDEARM HELD DOWN IN HIS RIGHT HAND.
Make one SOUTH-FACING walk cycle: the character faces the viewer, viewed from an elevated orthographic three-quarter game camera. Match reference painting. All 12 FULL-BODY frames show the SAME direction/camera/size/equipment, not a turnaround.
Layout STRICT 4 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS equal cells, read row-major, no labels/grid/text. Each pose centrally positioned in its cell, full silhouette never clips; feet on consistent baseline. Generous transparent gap between poses.
12 distinct sequential painted walk poses at 24fps covering TWO STEPS / one .5-second cycle:
1 left heel contact forward right foot trailing; 2 left foot accepting weight; 3 right heel lifting; 4 right swing passing stance leg; 5 right knee forward; 6 right foot extends to land;
7 right heel contact forward left trailing; 8 right foot accepting weight; 9 left heel lifting; 10 left swing passes; 11 left knee forward; 12 left foot extends to land. Frame 12 leads naturally into frame 1.
Weight cautious adult gait with subtle authentic pelvis/shoulder counterbalance, grounded boots, restrained short stride, quiet economical arms. Right hand never releases or changes the same pistol, muzzle down. Actual anatomy changes frame by frame, no copied or warped poses.
Medium: polished hand-painted illustrated 2D production sprite, realistic mature proportions, clean contour, detailed worn off-white enamel pressure suit, dark rubber and hardware. Consistent neutral diffuse light, no ground/cast shadow, no baked colored light, no emissive highlights. Preserve exact officer costume across all frames. Avoid chibi, toy proportions, fantasy, photoreal 3D render, giant gun, muzzle flashes, extra fingers, cut off feet, background, text. Actual alpha transparency.

generations.requestPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Original illustrated game character WALK ANIMATION SHEET; match the referenced mature adult white pressure-suited officer, helmet, belt, backpack, black joint fabric and pistol. Entire sheet EAST facing right, side/three-quarter profile, orthographic camera elevated 25 degrees. NOT a turnaround.
Exactly 12 distinct consecutive poses, 4 columns by 3 rows, equal cells with gaps. Transparent alpha. Full body all frames fixed scale, central hips at the same X in each cell, planted sole baseline identical; no clipping or shadows. Keep torso and head calm, pistol safely DOWN in right hand throughout. Hand-painted production game illustration, restrained neutral light. No text.
Critical animation instructions: a SINGLE two-foot walking cycle across all 12 cells. Each pose changes leg silhouette. Alternating long extension to legs together in passing to opposite extension. Not twelve variations of extended stride. No running, no duplicated contacts.
ROW ONE, left to right:
1. LEFT leg extended FORWARD to the RIGHT, heel contacting; right leg extended BACK to LEFT.
2. LEFT knee bends absorbing weight; RIGHT heel lifts behind.
3. LEFT leg supports torso vertical, RIGHT leg bent and lifting from behind.
4. PASSING pose: legs CLOSE TOGETHER under torso; LEFT foot planted, RIGHT bent knee passing forward.
ROW TWO:
5. RIGHT bent knee swings well FORWARD, LEFT straight stance foot slightly behind.
6. RIGHT shin extends forward for contact, LEFT heel lifts rear.
7. RIGHT leg extended FORWARD to RIGHT heel contacting; LEFT extended BACK to LEFT.
8. RIGHT knee bends absorbing; LEFT heel lifts behind.
ROW THREE:
9. RIGHT leg supports vertical; LEFT knee bent lifting behind.
10. PASSING: legs CLOSE TOGETHER under torso; RIGHT foot planted, LEFT bent knee passing forward.
11. LEFT knee swings forward, RIGHT straight stance foot behind.
12. LEFT shin extends forward to contact, RIGHT heel lifts rear.
Mirror the leg choreography, not the character; the backpack and pistol must not swap. Two actual steps at 24fps. Keep white rigid suit panels aligned on each limb, real fold changes at joints. No puppet warping or repeated static sprite. Do not change costume, adult proportions, weapon identity or camera.
